result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.fully_connect_nodes_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Create edges between all pairs of selected nodes (clique). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16840-L16946){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.fully_connect_nodes_ws(**edge_attributes) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Fully connect selected nodes](/assets/graphs/fully-connect-nodes-ws.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: nodes A, B, D, and E are selected in the accent color; they already form a square of four edges. Right: the two missing pairs get new accent edges, the diagonals A–E and B–D, so the four selected nodes form a clique; C and F are untouched." width="100%"} Adds edges to form a complete graph (clique) among all selected nodes. For directed graphs, creates edges in both directions. Skips edges that already exist. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [**edge_attributes]{.doc-parameter-name} : Optional attributes to set on newly created edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Adding edges between every pair among $n$ selected nodes yields up to $ inom{n}{2} = frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ new edges in an undirected graph and up to $n(n-1)$ in a directed one, since each pair contributes both directions. Existing edges are left untouched: nothing is duplicated or overwritten, so calling this on a partial clique only fills in the gaps. Any keyword arguments are copied onto every new edge, which is a natural way to tag a freshly-materialized clique with a shared label, weight, or type. ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#ba6c058b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node('A') graph.add_node('B') graph.add_node('C') # Create clique among selected nodes id_a = graph.get_id_from_label('A') id_b = graph.get_id_from_label('B') id_c = graph.get_id_from_label('C') (graph .select_nodes_by_id([id_a, id_b, id_c]) .fully_connect_nodes_ws(**{'type': 'clique', 'weight': 1.0}) ) # For undirected: 3 edges (A-B, A-C, B-C) # Returns 3 graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Directed clique (bidirectional edges): ::: {#5c2ad397 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph_directed = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph_directed.add_node(label='X') graph_directed.add_node(label='Y') x_id = graph_directed.get_id_from_label('X') y_id = graph_directed.get_id_from_label('Y') (graph_directed .select_nodes_by_id([x_id, y_id]) .fully_connect_nodes_ws() ) # Creates X->Y and Y->X # Returns 2 graph_directed.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
